skill_name: Briefly explain the difference between a VA and AI.
workflow: A virtual assistant (VA) is a human-in-the-loop software program designed to provide human-like responses to customer inquiries. It relies on pre-programmed inputs and conversations and can respond to customer inquiries in a more natural way than a simple AI system. On the other hand, artificial intelligence (AI) is a computer system that has the ability to learn and understand its environment with minimal to no human input.
